svg.text: TERE4AI v2 LLM-as-judge, exactly as implemented
Three separate judges (Anthropic Claude) gate the OpenAI generator. Mechanical, non-LLM checks run before and after every judge. No numeric thresholds:
the categorical verdict decides; the five scores are recorded evidence. An unusable judge response can never accept anything.
each quote must be a verbatim
never a bare truth edge; gate G4 fails
spans on both sides; served with the
RUNTIME - EVIDENCE EVALUATION AND BACKLOG, PAID PATHS (mcp_server/evidence.py, backlog.py)
WHERE EVERY JUDGE VALUE LIVES (nothing is hidden; build values are static per build, runtime values are per call)
verdict, rationale, all 5 scores, judge model,
636 alignment runs in the current build;
regenerated only by a new judged build or
one event per call with model, prompt version,
and judge_run_id; two identical paid calls
why the verdict gates and the scores only
The five recorded scores (defined in the judge prompts, clamped to [0,1], never thresholded):
semantic_similarity, normative_relevance, operational_utility, evidence_strength (surfaced as envelope confidence), judge_confidence.
The categorical verdict (accepted / rejected / needs_human_review) is the only thing that gates; fallback on unusable output is needs_human_review with all scores zeroed.
jq '.judge_runs[0]' data/graph_dumps/norms_core.json # one full extraction JudgeRun with scores
tail -3 data/review_queue/runtime_log.jsonl # latest runtime judge events
Independence: the generator is OpenAI, all judges are Anthropic Claude (DEC-07); the config loader rejects an OpenAI-family judge and both run at temperature 0.
Honest limits, stated: judge FA/FR rates are instrumented but unmeasured until the 50-decision human labeling (task 25); scores are recorded, not calibrated.
Sources: extract_norms/pipeline.py, align_hleg_altai/pipeline.py, judge/runtime_grounding.py, judge/audit_log.py, prompts/. Regenerate: scripts/make_judge_diagram.py
